description: A light, minimal 'atelier' aesthetic — quiet, confident, craftsmanship-focused. Modelled on a high-end restoration workshop, not a tech product. Product photography and precise language carry the interface; decoration is minimal. No gold, amber, navy, or saturated accents — the only colour comes from real watch photography.

color_tokens.notes: Never pure black or pure white for text. No gradients. No saturated colour anywhere in the UI chrome.

typography.heading_font: Playfair Display (high-contrast transitional serif), used large with tight leading; italics for supporting/contrast lines
typography.eyebrow: 11px, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.22em, muted gray (#6B6259), no colour, no pill/border

buttons.style: Small, near-rectangular (3px radius), uppercase, letter-spaced (0.14em), understated — not the star of the page
buttons.secondary: .btn-outline — transparent with hairline border, inverts to charcoal on hover
buttons.no: No pill shapes, no gradients, no bright fills

surfaces.card: .card — white background, 1px hairline #E4E1DA border, small radius (3-4px)
surfaces.dividers: hairline #E4E1DA; grouped lists use divide-y hairlines and a single outer border rather than floating shadowed cards
surfaces.shadows: avoid heavy shadows; rely on hairlines and whitespace

layout.approach: Generous whitespace, left-aligned editorial rhythm, mobile-first. Landing hero foregrounds a large watch photograph beside the text rather than a busy background.
layout.container: max-w-6xl for marketing, max-w-2xl/3xl for focused flows (wizard, report)

motion.loaders: rc-spin-slow ring in ink on light background

copy_tone.principle: Measured and declarative, never exclamatory. Build credibility through specific, verifiable-sounding detail rather than marketing adjectives.
copy_tone.headline_pattern: Two short contrasting phrases (e.g. 'Not a hunch. A documented identification.')
copy_tone.ctas: Short and quiet — 'Begin identification', 'Continue', 'Identify', 'Unlock the report'

imagery.usage: Real watch photography is the only source of colour. Frame photos in white cards with hairline borders and small captions/plate labels.

accessibility.contrast: #2A2420 on #F2F1EE / #FFFFFF meets AA for body and headings
accessibility.focus: inputs use ink border on focus

admin: Functional and neutral — same light palette, no editorial treatment required, must not clash.
